verdict.rationale: Pika is a generative media platform, and AI suggestions are a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only content generation and editing tools (video, image, audio, captions, scripts from premises), not AI-generated insights or suggestions derived from a user's own data. Generating new content, and the pricing card that matches a plan to your stated usage, are adjacent features rather than data-driven insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
